templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_LEVEL_ENTRY_SHARED
templates.behavior: Shared type-0x84 source with seven resources; callers select one of three animation roots, optional movement streams, and fixed level-entry coordinates.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_42_LEVEL_ENTRY
templates.behavior: Type-0x42 source with animation 0x00125874 and one resource; the caller derives the actor position from the level origin.

conclusion: The early level-entry block establishes two additional exact 20-byte actor-template records and makes the shared type-0x84 caller overrides explicit.
